title: あかりの灯る窓辺で、夜明けのラジオを聴きながら
author: 小鳥遊 ひなた

en.title: By the Lit-Up Window, Listening to the Dawn Radio
en.premise: This is the story of Minato, a young man who protects the radio station left behind by his late grandfather in an old apartment on the outskirts of town. Every morning, while the city is still asleep, he broadcasts a show reading listeners' modest wishes. One day, a letter arriving at the radio station asking, 'I want to know where migratory birds return to,' begins to set the townspeople's stopped time into motion. It is a story of gentleness melting into people's hearts along with the quiet dawn.

zh.title: 在亮着灯的窗边，收听黎明的广播
zh.premise: 这是一个关于青年凑的故事。他在镇子边缘的一间老旧公寓里，守护着已故祖父留下的广播电台。每天清晨，当城市还在沉睡时，他都会进行广播，朗读听众们微小的愿望。一天，电台收到了一封信，上面写着“我想知道候鸟归去的方向”，这封信开始转动镇上居民们停滞的时间。随着寂静的黎明到来，温柔的故事在人们的心中悄然流淌。
